items.followUp: What happens to the momentum of a gun and bullet when the gun is fired?

rubric.why: Award 1 mark for stating that total momentum is conserved.
rubric.description: States that the total momentum remains zero by conservation of momentum.
rubric.how: Look for conservation of momentum or the statement that total momentum remains zero.

rubric.why: Award 1 mark for describing the gun's motion relative to the bullet.
rubric.description: States that the gun moves backward, opposite to the bullet's direction.
rubric.how: Look for the gun moving backward or in the direction opposite to the bullet.

modelAnswer: Before firing, the gun and bullet are at rest, so their total momentum is zero.
When the bullet moves forward, the gun moves backward in the opposite direction; total momentum remains zero by conservation of momentum.
